name: KeywordBuddy
author: ticketbuddy

sections.description:
KeywordBuddy is an AI-powered SEO content platform. This plugin connects your WordPress site to your KeywordBuddy account, enabling:

  • Automated blog post publishing from your KeywordBuddy dashboard
  • Full SEO metadata support (Yoast SEO and RankMath)
  • Scheduled content publishing
  • One-click connection — no Application Passwords required

How to connect

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to your KeywordBuddy dashboard → Sites → Connect WordPress Site
  3. You will be redirected to your WordPress admin to approve the connection
  4. Click “Approve Connection” — that’s it

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.6 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • A KeywordBuddy account (https://ticketbuddy.ai/products/keywordbuddy/) — see Terms of Service

Privacy Policy

This plugin connects your WordPress site to KeywordBuddy (https://ticketbuddy.ai/products/keywordbuddy/).

When you approve the connection, your site URL is transmitted to KeywordBuddy’s servers to register your site. When publishing content, post data (title, content, SEO metadata) is sent from KeywordBuddy to your WordPress site via a secure API key. No data is collected or transmitted without your explicit approval.

For full details, see:

  • Privacy Policy: https://ticketbuddy.ai/privacy-policy/
  • Terms of Service: https://ticketbuddy.ai/terms-of-service/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the keywordbuddy folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings → KeywordBuddy and follow the connection instructions
sections.faq:
Do I need an Application Password?

No. This plugin handles authentication automatically with a secure API key — no Application Passwords needed.

Which SEO plugins are supported?

Yoast SEO and RankMath are both supported. The plugin detects which one is active and writes to the correct meta fields automatically.

How do I disconnect?

Go to Settings → KeywordBuddy and click the “Disconnect” button. You can also delete the site from your KeywordBuddy dashboard.
